tools.name: screen_evm_address
tools.description: Screen an EVM address for OFAC/mixer risk, contract bytecode, and EIP-1967 proxy status.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate EIP-1559 gas fees (slow/standard/fast/urgent), base fee trend, and congestion across Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum.

tools.name: simulate_transaction
tools.description: Run pre-flight eth_call and eth_estimateGas simulation with Solidity revert decoding, OFAC/mixer pre-check, and mempool guard warnings.

tools.name: check_rpc_health
tools.description: Probe multi-chain RPC endpoint latency, block height lag, and circuit-breaker health status.

tools.name: inspect_contract_invariants
tools.description: Inspect a smart contract, ERC-20 token, or DEX/Vault pool for proxy/admin slots, bytecode opcodes, ERC-20 sanity, and reserve invariants.

tools.name: diff_contract_snapshots
tools.description: Compute a risk diff between two AuditPulse inspection snapshots and format a webhook alert payload (generic, slack, or discord).

tools.name: verify_x402_payment
tools.description: Verify a Base Mainnet USDC x402 payment transaction receipt against the receive-only treasury.

tools.name: batch_screen_evm_addresses
tools.description: Screen up to 20 EVM addresses in parallel for OFAC/mixer risk, contract bytecode, and EIP-1967 proxy status ($0.05 Base USDC).
